_comment: Deterministic LLM replay for case 2 (Bronx school): tool calls then write_roadmap.

steps.message: Reviewing Marcus's Bronx school question and intake.

payload.name: NYSERDA school solar program (fictional stand-in)
payload.live_quote: This program is closed to new applications.

claims.text: No bills were uploaded, so the baseline is a benchmark of about 378,000 kWh/yr, not measured use.
claims.label: ASSUMPTION

claims.text: Rooftop solar of about 75 kW would produce about 90,000 kWh/yr, roughly 24% of benchmark use, so solar alone does not reach the 30% goal.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Please upload 12 months of bills and tell us the budget year and whether USD 250,000 is capital or annual; this will raise confidence.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: 42,000 sq ft elementary school built in 1962, flat roof of 9,000 sq ft, in the Bronx.
claims.label: FACT

claims.text: Public records match the intake for floor area and year built.
claims.label: FACT

claims.text: Public records suggest the roof is about 22 years old; no replacement year is recorded.
claims.label: FACT

claims.text: Baseline is a benchmark of 9 kWh per sq ft, about 378,000 kWh/yr. It is not measured use.
claims.label: ASSUMPTION

claims.text: Start with LED lighting and controls; savings use benchmark percentages until a building model exists.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Benchmark efficiency savings of 10-20% of annual use.
claims.label: ASSUMPTION

claims.text: C1 usable roof about 4,950 sq ft (9,000 x 0.55).
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: C3 solar covers about 23.8% of benchmark use (90,000 / 378,000).
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: C4 annual bill savings from solar about USD 19,800/yr at USD 0.22/kWh.
claims.label: ESTIMATE

claims.text: Solar should wait until the roof is surveyed; a roof this age may need replacing first.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Scenario A: LED and controls efficiency only (qualitative).
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Scenario B: efficiency, then re-roof, then solar within USD 250,000 (qualitative).
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Scenario C: efficiency, re-roof and a larger solar plan that may exceed the budget (qualitative).
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Federal elective pay for public entities is listed open (retrieved 2026-10-01, saved sample data).
claims.label: FACT

claims.text: The NYSERDA school solar program was saved as open 120 days ago (2026-06-03) but the live official page now says closed. It is left out of net cost.
claims.label: FACT

claims.text: Con Edison SC-9 Rate I, effective 2026-07-01, energy charge range. Confirm the tariff against a recent bill.
claims.label: FACT

claims.text: Net cost after incentives is not calculated yet; the financial model arrives in v5.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Phase 0: upload 12 months of bills and confirm the budget year and type.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Phase 1: LED lighting and controls.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Phase 2: commission a roof condition survey early, and plan re-roofing before any solar.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Phase 3: solar design, professional reviews and utility interconnection once the roof is sound.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: No critical loads were given. Tell us whether the school is used as an emergency shelter so backup power can be sized.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Licensed Professional Engineer or Registered Architect structural analysis for rooftop solar loads.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Roof condition survey by a qualified roofing contractor, before design.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: NYC licensed electrician for interconnection and service upgrades.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: FDNY rooftop access review for equipment layout.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Con Edison utility interconnection review and application.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

sections.title: Path to net-zero and learning resources

claims.text: Rooftop solar plus efficiency is unlikely to reach net-zero on this roof; plan off-site renewable procurement for the remainder.
claims.label: RECOMMENDATION

claims.text: Overall confidence is low. Missing: 12 months of bills, roof replacement year, budget year and type. Each would raise confidence.
claims.label: FACT

claims.text: Conflict: the saved incentive record said open, the live page says closed. The program is excluded, the conflict is shown, and the refreshed closed status was saved to the versioned cache.
